name: cog-second-brain
description: Self-evolving second brain with 33 AI agent skills, 10 agents, and people CRM. Closed-loop harness release: a V-model verification lifecycle (spec to evidence, criterion-traced checkpoints), read-only verifier agents that observe artifacts instead of trusting worker summaries, risk lanes, multi-session ultragoals with a north-star acceptance gate, plus craft skills for writing, visual work, and a paired anti-slop design system for marketing and product UI. Inspired by Garry Tan's gstack specialist sessions, gbrain knowledge patterns, and dwarves-kit closed-loop execution. Works with Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor, Kiro, Gemini CLI, Codex, and any markdown-reading agent.

features: Privacy-first architecture with strict domain separation
Plain text markdown files (no database, no vendor lock-in)
Multi-device sync via iCloud (iPhone, iPad, Mac)
Git version control for tracking thinking evolution
Worker agent architecture with model routing (Sonnet workers, Opus lead)
People CRM with tiered enrichment and evidence-based profiles
Runtime trust: memory-hygiene sweeps with last_verified + confidence stamps
Skill post-condition checks - observe the mutated artifact before reporting success
Skill distillation pattern: explore once with a strong model, execute cheap with a small one
V-model closed loop: decompose to falsifiable criteria, verify with evidence traced back to each one
Read-only verifier agents (task-verifier, integration-verifier) that observe artifacts, not worker summaries
Risk lanes: ceremony scales with blast radius instead of applying uniformly
Ultragoals: multi-session goals with per-phase verification and a final north-star acceptance gate
Cross-model flagship gate - a different model family catches a different error class
Paired anti-slop design skills: taste-skill owns marketing surfaces, product-ui-taste owns dense product UI
